::: {.solutions}

**Show all your reasoning.** Total: **71 marks** · Suggested time: **90 minutes**. This set spans both clinics —
the basic moves (Clinic 1) and the harder combinations (Clinic 2).

> **A modulus splits into cases at its corner.** $\lvert A\rvert=B$ needs $B\ge0$ and $A=\pm B$;
> $\lvert A\rvert=\lvert B\rvert$ needs $A=\pm B$; $\lvert A\rvert<k$ is $-k<A<k$.

> **$\lvert f(x)\rvert$** flips the below-axis part **up**; **$f(\lvert x\rvert)$** mirrors the right half in
> the $y$-axis (always even). A **sum of $\lvert x-a_i\rvert$** is least at the **median** of the $a_i$.

| Section | What it covers | Marks |
|---|---|---|
| **A — Equations & inequalities** | case-splitting · $\lvert A\rvert=\lvert B\rvert$ · "for all $k$" counts · modulus-quadratic | 20 |
| **B — Graphs, $x\lvert x\rvert$ & regions** | $\lvert f\rvert$ vs $f(\lvert x\rvert)$ · $x\lvert x\rvert$ counting · diamonds & their areas | 23 |
| **C — Integrals, distances & nesting** | split-at-the-corner integrals · even symmetry · distance sums · kites · nested modulus · triangle inequality | 28 |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Answer form.** Equations → **list every solution** (and reject any that fail its case). Inequalities →
**interval notation**. "How many solutions" → **a whole number**. Areas → **exact value**. Sketches → label
every corner, root and turning point.
:::
